1: An easy to follow warm up routine before a bouldering session

This 6-week program is designed for bouldering specialists new to structured power endurance training that would like to improve their fitness on longer boulder problems.  The template is designed to be split across two training days per week.  The first training day should consist of the Warm-up, followed by project bouldering using the Style Triad workout, and then either Drop Intervals (Weeks 1-3) or 6 in 6 (Weeks 3-6) to complete the session.  The second training day will consist of the Warm-up, followed by Boulder Triples (except on Week 3).  Additional sessions can be added to this plan in order to maintain strength & power.
